race.comment: DANCE OF DRAGONS (4) stuck on well over 1200m at Pinjarra on debut in a strong debut performance. He showed good ability there and had trialled coming into the debut. The inside barrier should see him a little closer in the run and with natural improvement on the cards, he'll be hard to hold out. SPONGE CAKE (9) resumes today with Pike in the saddle following a solid trial in readiness for her return. She improved with racing through her debut campaign and if she can pick up from where she left off, she'll be hard to hold out. LONG LAUGH (1) led them up last start at Belmont over 1200m on the heavy deck and felt the pinch late. Firmer footing this time should help him and he should get every chance if good enough. OSCARS NO GROUCH (2) gets the blinkers on for the first time today and steps out in distance. Can fire a shot despite the wide draw. GLORANARDO (3) can feature second-up in the campaign.
